personality_notes: Beast warrior, protective, nature-connected, speaks with wisdom and patience

first_meet_generic: You carry yourself... differently. I sense no threat.
The spirits whisper about you. They are... amused.
Greetings. I am Korr. The wilds have taught me to respect all beings.
Your path is your own. But our paths cross today.
barrelman: Barrels are practical. Wood is from nature. I approve.
You store things? Nature stores things too. Seeds. Nuts. Wisdom.
A simple life. There is honor in simplicity.
Do your barrels breathe? Wood should breathe.
snakecharmer: The snake respects you. That is no small thing.
Animals know true hearts. You must have one.
Mr. Whiskers? An... unusual name for such a creature.
The flute speaks a language older than words.
lucha: Your strength is impressive. But strength without purpose is just... force.
The mask hides nothing from the spirits. They see true faces.
Combat as art. I understand this. Nature is also violent and beautiful.
You wrestle with more than opponents. I can see it.
ironchef: Cooking in armor. Impractical. But dedication is admirable.
Food is sacred. You treat it with fire. Respect.
The spirits appreciate those who feed others.
Can you taste through metal? Or do you cook by instinct?
trenchcoat: You hide much. The forest has secrets too. But it does not boast.
Mystery is a cloak. But all cloaks fall eventually.
I sense no malice. Only... weight. Heavy burdens.
The shadows do not frighten me. I was raised in them.
sumo: Stillness is power. You have learned this lesson well.
The mountain does not move. Yet it shapes the world.
Your center is solid. Many lack this foundation.
I would not test you. Wisdom knows when not to fight.
foodboys: Brothers. Family is important. Even strange family.
Food sustains. You serve a noble purpose.
Which one are you? It matters not. You are both... loud.
Your energy reminds me of spring. Chaotic. Growing.
coolcat: You move like a predator. But you do not hunt. Interesting.
Cool? The wind is cool. Night is cool. You are... something else.
Music is a form of communion. Even with yourself.
The sunglasses hide your eyes. But not your spirit.
pigman: Pigs are intelligent creatures. You honor them well.
The inn smells of comfort. Of home. This is good.
Nature provides. You seem to understand this.
Your laughter echoes like forest sounds. Natural. Unforced.
tunneler: The earth speaks to those who dig. Do you listen?
Dark places hold wisdom. But also danger. Be careful.
Your back will ache. Nature asks much of those who delve.
Retirement on water? From earth to sky. A journey.
bush: That is... not a bush. The spirits whisper confusion.
Nature has many forms. This one is new to me.
Are you... hiding? Or waiting? Or something else?
The wilds accept all. Even those who should not be.
aeronaut: Balloons in the sky. Like dandelion seeds. Fragile. Brave.
You seek altitude. The eagle understands this.
The wind is fickle. You trust it. Courage or foolishness?
What do you see from above? The world is different from heights.
onionboss: Leadership is a burden. The pack leader carries much.
You are shaped by your environment. As are we all.
The workers need guidance. But also respect. Balance this.
Do you make others cry? Like your namesake? A joke.
astronaut: Deep waters. Like deep forests. Full of mystery.
The suit protects. Armor is necessary for dangerous places.
What lives below? Things we cannot imagine. Be careful.
You explore the unknown. This is honorable.
conductor: The train moves on set paths. Like rivers. Natural.
You keep schedule. Nature has schedules too. Migration. Seasons.
All aboard? A call to journey. I understand this.
The uniform shows purpose. Purpose is important.
shoewoman: The deer needs no shoes. But humans are fragile.
Proper footing is important. In nature and in life.
You protect feet. Feet carry us on our journey. Respect.
Do you have boots for... rough terrain? Very rough?
signguy: Signs mark territory. Animals do this too.
Your work guides travelers. A service to the lost.
Hand-painted? Like cave paintings. Old ways. Good ways.
Messages for all to see. Communication is vital.
cobra: The cobra commands respect. Distance. Caution.
Beautiful and deadly. Nature's perfect design.
I will not approach. I know better than to tempt fate.
The scales shimmer like water. hypnotic. Dangerous.
barrelgob: Living in a barrel. Like a hermit crab. Adapting.
You make shelter where you find it. Resourceful.
Is it warm? Dry? Shelter is important for survival.
The wilds teach us to use what the world provides.
twins: Two as one. Like wolves in a pack. Bonded.
You share a connection deeper than words. I can sense it.
Finish each other's thoughts? The pack does this too.
Separate? No? Some bonds cannot be broken.
sunandmoon: The sky speaks to those who listen. You listen well.
Sun and moon. Day and night. Balance. Important.
The stars guide. But they do not command. Remember this.
Your headdress is heavy. Wisdom often is.
